Both let me jot "Read the section on promises" as I save, and both show the note right on the saved card, which is what I want — optional, added in the moment, and easy to see later.

For keeping the quick-save feeling, I'd go with revealing the note field when I need it. Most of the time I just paste and save, so tucking the note behind a little "Add a note" keeps the form clean and fast, and it's right there the moment I do want to write something. The always-visible field is fine too, but the reveal keeps the everyday save feeling lighter.
